title: Probing Entanglement Scaling Across a Quantum Phase Transition on a Quantum Computer
abstract_summary: First demonstration of log-law entanglement entropy scaling at criticality on a digital quantum computer, using MERA tensor networks on a fully-connected trapped-ion system. Holographic subsystem tomography reveals quantum phase transition with spontaneous symmetry breaking. Can accurately represent infinite systems with few qubits.
relevance_reason: Direct experimental MERA on trapped-ion hardware (same hardware family as Quantinuum Helios). Demonstrates precisely the type of experiment our paper proposes. Shows MERA captures critical CFT physics on current hardware.
connection_to_project: This is the experimental realization closest to our proposed Helios experiment. Barthel is co-author — connects to Miao & Barthel 2025 (PAPER-2026 index) Trotterized MERA convergence proof. Validates our hardware approach.
